messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline tidy-round: commit updates + leadership pack intake
Attachments: 2026-09-leadership-pack-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Folks —

Quick kickoff for the monthly tidy-round and leadership pack intake. Goal: have stage/commit fidelity and a first-pass leadership packet assembled by EOD Wednesday (09/09) so finance can reconcile for our monthly close.

Please do the following by the deadline listed:

- Update the shared Pipeline Sheet (link below) with: latest commit amount, stage (SQL/Proposal/Commit), expected close week, and owner. Mark rows that are at risk with the red flag column.
- For any changes >= 20% vs prior commit, attach a one-page rationale (PDF) to the Drive folder and note the file name in the "notes" column.
- If a deal requires leadership context (discount request, legal or SOC ask, procurement delay), flag it in the "leadership_note" column so we can include a slide.
- I attached the leadership pack checklist (simple tab items) — use the template in the Drive folder for any slides.

Deadlines:
- Managers update sheet: Wednesday 09/09 by 3pm PT
- Consolidation + first-pass pack: Thursday 09/10 by 11am PT

Links: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XyZ_pipelinesheet
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/leadership-pack-2026-09
HubSpot reference: HubSpot:deal/12345678

Short ask in the body: who is taking point on Acme Systems? They show as a late Q3 commit but procurement is slow — need a short risk note.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Manager, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline tidy-round: commit updates + leadership pack intake

Ack — taking point on consolidation. I'll update the sheet by Wednesday noon and flag all 20%+ moves.

Quick note on Acme Systems: procurement notified the AE this morning of an internal finance hold while they complete a SOC 2 checklist. I asked for a target week but didn't get a firm date. Forwarding the relevant line from Elaine below so we have the exact language for the leadership slide.

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Elaine Park <elaine@acmesystems.com>
Date: Tue, Sep 7, 2026 at 10:33 AM PDT
To: Roberto Silva <roberto@acmesystems.com>
Subject: Re: Redwood quote and SOC items

Hi Roberto,

We need the SOC evidence (sys logs and retention policy) completed before we can sign. Can Redwood provide a SOC statement and a contact for the security review? Without that, finance will hold payments.

Thanks,
Elaine

I'll add this as a leadership note and request the security contact from PM. Marissa

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline tidy-round: commit updates + leadership pack intake
Attachments: leadership_brief_template.pptx (pptx stub)

Agree with Marissa — I'll build one slide for the leadership pack that calls out:
- Acme Systems: procurement/SOC hold, ask = provide SOC contact and expected remediation timing.
- Financial impact: $360k commit, risk = delayed close into Oct if hold persists.
- Recommendation: brief approval to provide SOC artifacts and a short grace on billing if the legal timeline pushes out.

I can drop the slide into the Drive folder once Marissa confirms the exact wording and whether we need a discount ask documented. Using the attached template.

Jonas
Head of Sales Operations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline tidy-round: commit updates + leadership pack intake

Thanks team — updates below and confirmed owners in the sheet.

- All managers: great discipline so far. Please ensure "expected close week" is set for every commit (no blanks).
- Acme Systems: owner = Roberto Silva (AE). Marissa: please work with Roberto and Security to get the SOC contact. Jonas: add the slide as discussed; if Roberto indicates a material discount ask, note it as an "escalation" so I can route to Ops.
- Consolidation timeline confirmed: I will review the first-pass leadership pack on Thursday 09/10 at 11am PT. If any commit changes > 20% after consolidation, we will mark it as a post-close adjustment and require a separate FYI.

Attachments I added to the Drive folder: Acme_Q3_commit_summary.pdf (summary), leadership_brief_template.pptx

Appreciate everyone's speed on this — last ask: managers, put any evidence PDFs in the Drive and drop the filename in the sheet.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
